summary: Migration verification complete: Golden Pirates site is 100% functional across all devices (desktop 1920x1080, tablets 1024x768/768x1024, mobile 390x844/320x568/844x390). All core features tested: home page with 6 sections, bilingual FR/EN switching, apply form, recruit tracking (/suivi), admin council space (/admin) with login/dashboard/registry/messagerie/exports, donations page, conditions page, and SEO files (robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt). Backend API: 12/16 tests passed (75%), with failures only in donation invoice features due to missing test data (LOHMIN RUI) in fresh migration. Complete application flow verified: create → track → admin view → delete.
